# New renderings chosen in iliad-070 (Iliad 11.655–803)

| Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| τίπτε τὰρ … ὀλοφύρεται (11.656) | "Why ever, then, does Achilles so grieve for" | "Why does Achilles grieve like this for" | "lament", "mourn" (each changes the verb); ὀλοφύρομαι "grieve for" as in the table’s ὀλοφυρόμεθ’ (8.33) |
| βεβλήαται · βεβλημένοι · οὐτάμενοι · οὔτασται (11.657–661) | "have … been struck" · "struck" · "wounded" · "wounded is" | "have been struck" · "struck" · "wounded" · "is wounded" | "hit" (kept for none of these), "pierced", "stabbed" (each decides the weapon); βάλλω "strike", οὐτάω "wound", kept apart in the pair βεβλημένοι οὐτάμενοί τε |
| κέαται (11.659) | "lie" | "lie" | "are laid", "rest"; epic third plural of κεῖμαι |
| θέρωνται (νῆες … πυρὸς δηΐοιο θέρωνται, 11.667) | "are warmed by hostile fire" | "are set burning by hostile fire" (+ note: the verb is literally "be warmed", a grim understatement) | "are heated through", "feel the heat of", "are consumed"; πυρὸς δηΐοιο keeps the table’s "hostile fire" |
| ἀέκητι (Ἀργείων ἀέκητι, 11.667) | "against the will of" | "against the will of" | "in spite of", "without the consent of"; ἀέκητι + genitive |
| ἐπισχερώ (11.668) | "in a row" | "one after another" | "in succession", "in a line", "all together"; LSJ "in a line, in succession" |
| ἲς … γναμπτοῖσι μέλεσσιν (11.668–669) | "force … in my pliant limbs" | "strength … in my supple limbs" | "bending", "strong"; follows the Odyssey table’s ἲς "force" / "strength" (11.393) and its γναμπτοῖσι μέλεσσι "pliant" / "supple limbs" (11.394) |
| βοηλασίη (11.672) | "cattle-driving" | "a cattle-raid" | "cattle-lifting", "a raid on cattle" (adds theft to the noun), "a cattle-drive"; βοῦς + ἐλαύνω |
| ἐτύχθη (νεῖκος ἐτύχθη, 11.671) | "a quarrel arose" | "a quarrel arose" | "was made", "was begun"; passive aorist of τεύχω read as "came about"; νεῖκος keeps "quarrel" |
| ῥύσι’ ἐλαυνόμενος (11.674) | "driving off goods in reprisal" | "driving off goods in reprisal" | "pledges", "reprisal-cattle", "booty"; ῥύσιον is what is seized to make good a debt, and ἐλαυνόμενος the middle "drive off for oneself" |
| ἤλιθα πολλήν (11.677) | "exceeding much" | "a very great" | "an abundance of", "plentiful", "untold"; ἤλιθα "exceedingly" |
| ξανθάς (ἵππους, 11.680) | "chestnut" | "chestnut" | "fair" (kept for ξανθός of hair), "yellow", "tawny" (the table avoids "tawny" for αἴθων), "golden"; a colour word for horses, feminine because they are mares |
| ἐλίγαινον (11.685) | "cried out clearly" | "cried out clearly" | "proclaimed in shrill tones", "shrilled" (the table’s λιγύς is "clear"); λιγαίνω "cry in a clear voice" |
| ἠοῖ φαινομένηφι (11.685) | "with dawn appearing" | "at first light" | follows the Odyssey table’s ἅμ’ ἠοῖ φαινομένηφιν (16.270) |
| δαιτρεύω · δαίτρευον (11.688) · δαιτρεύειν (11.705) | "made the division" · "to divide" | "made the division" · "to divide" | "feasted" (keeps δαίς "feast" in the root only), "shared out", "carved"; δαιτρεύω "divide into portions", the finite verb at 688 with the noun "the division", the infinitive of purpose at 705 plain "to divide" |
| κακόω · ἐκάκωσε · κεκακωμένοι (11.689–690) | "ill-treated" | "ill-treated" | "harmed", "wronged", "afflicted"; the verb is the same at both places and the English keeps one word |
| ὑπερηφανέοντες · ὑβρίζοντες (11.694–695) | "behaving overbearingly" · "behaving insolently to" | "overbearing in this" · "treated … with insolence" | "arrogant" (reserved for ὑπερφίαλος and ὑπερηνορέοντες in the table), "violent" (reserved for ὑβρισταί), "outrage"; ὕβρις keeps "insolence" |
| ἀθλοφόροι (ἵπποι, 11.699) | "prize-bearing" | "prize-bearing" | "prize-winning" (they had not yet won), "racing"; ἆθλον + φέρω |
| ἄεθλα (μετ’ ἄεθλα, 11.700) | "to the contests" | "to the contests" | "for the prizes" (the word can mean either; the note says so); follows the table’s ἄεθλον "contest" |
| τρίπους · θεύσεσθαι (11.700–701) | "tripod" · "to run" | "tripod" · "to run" | "cauldron", "to race"; ἔμελλον + future infinitive "were going to" |
| ἐλατήρ (11.702) | "the driver" | "the driver" | "charioteer" (reserved for ἡνίοχος), "horseman"; ἐλαύνω "drive" |
| κάσχεθε (11.702) | "held back" | "kept … there" | "seized", "detained", "kept back"; κατέχω aorist |
| ἄσπετα πολλά (11.704) | "boundless, many things" | "a boundless amount" | "countless", "untold riches"; follows the table’s ἄσπετα κρέα "boundless meat" |
| ἀτεμβόμενος · ἴσης (11.705) | "cheated" · "an equal share" | "cheated of an equal share" | "defrauded", "deprived", "short of his due"; ἀτέμβομαι "be cheated", ἴση the equal share understood; the whole clause μή τίς οἱ … κίοι ἴσης takes the Odyssey’s English at 9.42 and 9.549 (`l` "so that no one, for him, cheated, should go off short of an equal share", `i` "so that no one, on his account, should go away cheated of an equal share") |
| δῆμος (ἐς δῆμον, 11.704) | "the people" | "the people" | "the land" (the table’s δῆμος of territory); follows the Odyssey table’s δῆμος as object of fear (16.425), where the people are meant, and λαός keeps "people" (`l`) and "troops" (`i`) |
| διείπομεν (11.706) | "arranged" | "settled" | "told over", "recounted", "went through"; from διά + εἶπον "say", of settling a matter one item at a time |
| ἕρδομεν ἱρὰ θεοῖς (11.707) | "performed sacrifices to the gods" | "performed sacrifices to the gods" | "offered", "made"; follows the table’s ἱερά "sacrifices" and ῥέζω "perform" |
| Μολίονε (11.709, 11.750) | "the two Molions" (709) · "the two of Actor’s line, the Molions" (750) | "the two Molions" (709) · "the pair of Actor’s line, the Molions" (750) | "the Molione", "the Molionids", "sons of Molione"; a dual naming the pair, taken with the table’s Ἀκτορίωνε (2.621) "the two of Actor’s line" / "the pair of Actor’s line" |
| ἀμφιστρατάομαι (ἀμφεστρατόωντο, 11.713) · ἀμφέσταν (11.733) | "were encamped around" · "had … taken their stand about" | "camped around" · "had … taken their stand around" | "besieged", "surrounded"; ἀμφί + στρατάομαι "encamp", ἀμφίστημι aorist "stand around" |
| μετεκίαθον (11.714) | "had traversed" | "had crossed" | "pursued", "gone among"; μετακιαθέω "go through"; subject the Epeans, carried over from 713 |
| ἔννυχος · ἐννύχιοι (11.716 · 11.683) | "in the night" · "by night" | "in the night" · "by night" | "at night" (both), "nocturnal"; adjective used as adverb |
| ἄμμι (11.714) | "to us" | "to us" | epic dative of ἡμεῖς |
| ἀέκοντα … ἐσσυμένους (11.716–717) | "not unwilling … very eager" | "not unwilling but very eager" | "reluctant", "hasty"; ἀέκων "unwilling" (the table’s ἀέκοντος), ἐσσυμένος "eager" |
| μετέπρεπον (11.720) | "was conspicuous among" | "was conspicuous among" | "stood out among" (the table lists it as avoided only where ἔξοχος stood beside); follows the table’s μεταπρέπω "is conspicuous among" (2.481) |
| ὧς ἄγε νεῖκος Ἀθήνη (11.721) | "in this way Athena led the quarrel" | "that was how Athena led the quarrel" | "directed the battle", "waged the war" (νεῖκος keeps "quarrel"); ἄγω "lead" |
| ἔθνεα πεζῶν · ἐπέρρεον (11.724) | "the tribes of men on foot" · "flowed up" | "the bands of men on foot" · "flowed up" | "hosts", "nations", "swarms" (the table’s `i` for ἔθνεα in the similes of bees, birds and flies, 2.87, 2.459, 2.469; these are men on foot, not a simile); `l` keeps the table’s "tribes" and `i` takes "bands" from the table’s ἔθνος ἑταίρων "band" (7.115); ἔθνος "body of people" |
| ἔνδιοι (11.726) | "at midday" | "at midday" | "at noon", "in the heat of the day"; adjective used as adverb |
| ἱερὸν ῥόον (11.726) | "the sacred stream" | "the sacred stream" | "holy", "divine current"; ἱερός "sacred", ῥόος "stream" |
| ὑπερμενεῖ (Διί, 11.727) | "exceeding-strong" | "of surpassing strength" | "mighty", "overbearing"; follows the table’s ὑπερμενής (13.205, 7.480) |
| βοῦν ἀγελαίην (11.729) | "a cow of the herd" | "a cow from the herd" | the Odyssey table’s row (17.181), unchanged |
| ἔργον Ἄρηος (11.734) | "a great work of Ares" | "a great work of Ares" | "the toil of war", "the business of Ares"; ἔργον "work" with the god’s name for war |
| συμφερόμεσθα (11.736) | "we clashed" | "we met" | "we joined battle" (adds a phrase), "we came together"; συμφέρομαι "come together" in a fight |
| ὑπερέσχεθε γαίης (11.735) | "held itself above the earth" | "rose above the earth" | "rose over the earth", "climbed"; ὑπερέχω aorist |
| κόμισσα (11.738) | "took charge of" | "took charge of" | "carried off", "took away", "seized"; κομίζω "take care of" as in the table’s κομίσσατο (8.284), here the horses of a man just killed |
| γαμβρός (11.739) | "son-in-law" | "a son-in-law" | "brother-in-law"; a daughter’s husband here |
| Μούλιος (11.739) | "Mulius" | "Mulius" | "Moulios"; Latinised like the other Greek names |
| χαλκήρεϊ δουρί (11.742) | "bronze-fitted spear" | "bronze-fitted spear" | the table’s row (4.469, 5.309), unchanged |
| ἤριπε δ’ ἐν κονίῃσιν (11.743) | "crashed down in the dust" | "crashed down in the dust" | follows the table’s ἤριπε "crashed down" (4.462) |
| ἄλλυδις ἄλλος (11.745) | "one this way, one that" | "one this way and one that" | "in all directions", "every which way", "another that" (the table’s ἄλλυδις ἄλλος, 11.486, keeps "one that"); the Greek has two directions, not all |
| ἔτρεσαν (11.745) | "trembled" | "flinched and scattered" | "fled" (the verb covers both, and ἄλλυδις ἄλλος supplies the scattering); follows the table’s τρέσσε "trembled" / "flinched" |
| κελαινῇ λαίλαπι ἶσος (11.747) | "like a dark squall" | "like a dark squall" | "black storm", "tempest", "hurricane"; follows the table’s λαῖλαψ "squall" and κελαινός "dark" |
| δύο δ’ ἀμφὶς ἕκαστον φῶτες (11.748–749) | "about each two men" | "two men for each" | "on either side of each", "round each"; ἀμφίς "around" |
| ὀδὰξ ἕλον οὖδας (11.749) | "with their teeth bit the ground" | "bit the earth with their teeth" | the Odyssey table’s row (22.269), unchanged |
| ἀλάπαξα (Μολίονε παῖδ’ ἀλάπαξα, 11.750) | "I would have laid waste" | "I would have laid waste" | "cut down", "slain", "destroyed" (each changes the verb); ἀλαπάζω "lay waste" as in the table, here of persons |
| εὐρὺ κρείων ἐνοσίχθων (11.751) | "wide-ruling earth-shaker" | "the wide-ruling earth-shaker" | "lord earth-shaker" (the Odyssey’s κρείων ἐνοσίχθων), "mighty"; εὐρὺ κρείων keeps the Agamemnon row’s "wide-ruling", ἐνοσίχθων "earth-shaker" |
| ἐγγυάλιξε (μέγα κράτος, 11.753) | "put into their hands … great strength" | "put great strength into the hands of" | "gave", "granted victory"; ἐγγυαλίζω "put into the hands", κράτος "strength" as in the table (1.509) |
| σπιδέος πεδίοιο (11.754) | "the broad plain" | "the broad plain" | "wide", "open"; σπιδής "wide, spacious" |
| ἀνὰ … ἔντεα καλὰ λέγοντες (11.755) | "gathering up the fine gear" | "gathering up the fine gear" | "picking up", "collecting the weapons", "armour" (reserved for τεύχεα); ἀναλέγω "gather up", ἔντεα "gear" as in the table’s ἔντεα (3.339) and at 731 (ἐν ἔντεσιν, "in his own gear") |
| βήσαμεν ἵππους (11.756) | "made our horses go" | "brought our horses" | "drove", "halted"; causative aorist of βαίνω |
| Βουπράσιον · Ἀλήσιον · Ὠλενίη · Θρυόεσσα · Ἀρήνη · Μινυήϊος · Ὑπειροχίδης · Ἀγαμήδη (names, 11.711–756) | "Buprasium" · "Alesium" · "Olenian" · "Thryoessa" · "Arene" · "Minyeïus" · "Hypeirochus" · "Agamede" | same | "Bouprasion", "Alesion"; Latinised like the other Greek names, with neuter -ον names given Latin -um as in the table’s Thryum and Dium |
| εὐχετόωντο (11.761) | "prayed" | "offered their prayers" (+ note: the verb also means "vow" or "boast") | "gave thanks", "praised", "boasted"; εὐχετάομαι "pray" with the sense of honour paid noted |
| ὣς ἔον, εἴ ποτ’ ἔον γε (11.762) | "So was I, if ever I was" | "That is what I was, if ever I was" | "such was I", "so I was, if ever"; ἔον first-person imperfect |
| ἀρετῆς ἀπονήσεται (11.763) | "will have the benefit of his excellence" | "will have the benefit of his excellence" | "enjoy his valour", "profit from his prowess"; follows the table’s ἀρετή "excellence" (8.535); ἀπονίνημι "have the benefit of" is new here |
| μετακλαύσεσθαι (11.764) | "will greatly weep afterwards" | "will weep greatly afterwards" | "lament", "regret", "long"; μετά "afterwards" + κλαίω, πολλά used adverbially as "greatly" in both layers |
| ὦ πέπον (11.765) | "O good one" | "My good fellow" | the published rendering (iliad-054, 9.252), unchanged |
| Ἀχαιΐς (κατ’ Ἀχαιΐδα πουλυβότειραν, 11.770) | "Achaea, the much-nourishing" | "Achaea, that feeds so many" | "the Achaean land" (loses the one-word name), "all-nourishing"; follows the table’s πουλυβότειρα "much-nourishing" / "that feeds so many" (8.378) |
| ἥρως (ἥρωα Μενοίτιον, 11.771) | "the hero" | "the hero" | "warrior", "lord"; ἥρως "hero" |
| αὐλῆς ἐν χόρτῳ (11.774) | "in the enclosure of the court" | "in the enclosure of the courtyard" | "in the yard", "in the middle of the court"; χόρτος "enclosure" |
| ἀμφὶ βοὸς … κρέα ἕπετον (11.776) | "were busy about the flesh of the ox" | "were busy with the flesh of the ox" | "followed", "attended to the meat" (each loses the verb’s "be busy about"); ἕπω |
| προθύροισι (11.777) | "in the forecourt" | "in the forecourt" | "porch", "gateway", "doorway"; πρόθυρον "space before the door" |
| ξείνιά τ’ εὖ παρέθηκεν (11.779) | "set out well the things due to guests" | "set out the hospitality due to guests" | "guest-gifts" (kept for ξεινήιον), "a good meal", "the hospitality" alone in `l`; follows the Odyssey table’s ξείνια δῶκα (14.404) "the things due to guests" / "the hospitality due to guests" |
| ἦρχον … μύθοιο (11.781) | "I began the speech" | "I began to speak" | "led the talk", "opened the conversation"; ἄρχω + genitive "begin" |
| τάρπημεν ἐδητύος ἠδὲ ποτῆτος (11.780) | "had taken our fill of food and of drink" | "had taken our fill of food and drink" | "were satisfied with", "had enough of"; the table’s τέρπω "take one’s fill" |
| λήθεαι (11.790) | "you forget" | "you forget it" | "you are forgetting", "you have forgotten"; present middle of λήθομαι |
| σὺν δαίμονι (11.792) | "with some power" | "with some power’s help" | "with a god’s help", "with heaven’s help" (reserved for θεός); follows the table’s δαίμων "some power" |
| θυμὸν ὀρίναις (11.792) | "you might stir his heart" | "you might stir his heart" | "rouse his spirit", "move his soul"; follows the table’s θυμός "heart" and ὀρίνω "stir" (3.395) |
| παραίφασις (11.793) | "persuasion" | "persuasion" | "exhortation", "encouragement", "counsel" (kept for ὑποθέσθαι); a rare noun, "talking round" |
| ἑταῖρος (11.793) | "companion" | "companion" | "comrade", "friend"; follows the table’s ἑταῖροι "companions" |
| θεοπροπίην ἀλεείνει (11.794) | "some prophecy he is shunning" | "he is shunning some prophecy" | "oracle", "avoids"; θεοπροπίη "prophecy" (1.384–385), ἀλεείνω "shun" |
| ἐπέφραδε (11.795) | "has pointed out" | "has told him of one" | "revealed", "declared"; φράζω "point out" |
| προέτω (11.796) | "let him send forth" | "let him send you out" | "let him let go", "release"; προίημι "send forth" |
| εἴσκοντες (11.799) | "taking you for him" | "taking you for him" | "likening you to", "mistaking you for"; εἴσκω "liken, take to be" |
| ἀναπνεύσωσι · ἀνάπνευσις (11.800–801) | "may get breath again" · "breathing-space" | "get their breath back" · "breathing-space" | "recover", "rest" · "respite", "relief"; ἀναπνέω "breathe again" |
| ἀρήϊοι υἷες Ἀχαιῶν (11.800) | "the warlike sons of the Achaeans" | "the warlike sons of the Achaeans" | "the war-loving", "the fighting sons"; follows the table’s ἀρήϊος "warlike" and υἷες Ἀχαιῶν "the sons of the Achaeans" (1.162) |
| τειρόμενοι (11.801) | "worn down" | "worn down" | "wearied", "distressed", "exhausted"; τείρω "wear down" |
| ἀκμῆτες · κεκμηότας (11.802) | "fresh" · "weary" | "being fresh" · "tired out" | "unwearied", "untired" · "exhausted"; ἀκμήτης "untired", κεκμηώς perfect of κάμνω |
| ἀϋτῇ (11.802) | "with a battle-cry" | "with a battle-cry" | "with a shout", "with a cry"; ἀϋτή "battle-cry" as in the table (4.328, 9.547) |
| κλισιάων (11.803) | "the huts" | "the huts" | "tents"; the table’s κλισίη "hut" |
| ῥεῖα … ὤσαισθε (11.802–803) | "easily you … could push back" | "easily … you could drive … back" | "readily", "lightly"; ὠθέω "push" |
